title: Vision, Mission And Core Values
text: Paragon International University strives to become a leading, private, higher education institution in Cambodia in terms of the quality of teaching, research, student enrichment, community service, as well as regional and global engagement. In order for this vision to be realized, Paragon International University pursues the following missions: – Responsibility – Integrity – Discovery – Excellence To accomplish the aforementioned missions, Paragon International University aims to do the followings:

title: Educational Philosophy - Academic Excellence and Critical Thinking
text: At Paragon International University, we are committed to fostering a dynamic learning environment that nurtures intellectual curiosity and academic excellence. Our educational philosophy centers on developing students who are not only well-versed in their academic disciplines but also equipped with the critical skills necessary to navigate and address the complex challenges of the modern world.

title: Educational Philosophy - Inquiry and Applied Learning
text: We believe that education is a transformative experience that empowers students to engage meaningfully with the world around them. Our programs are designed to cultivate a passion for inquiry, encouraging students to ask thought-provoking questions, explore diverse perspectives, and seek innovative solutions. Through rigorous academic study, research opportunities, and real-world application, students learn to integrate knowledge and practice to become leaders in their chosen fields.

title: Educational Philosophy - Soft Skills and RIDE Core Values
text: In addition to academic expertise, we emphasize the development of essential soft skills, such as critical thinking, creativity, effective communication, teamwork, and ethical decision-making. These competencies are integrated throughout our curricula and reinforced through diverse experiential learning opportunities, including internships, projects, and workshops. Central to our mission is the cultivation of our core values: Responsibility, Integrity, Discovery, and Excellence (RIDE). These values guide not only academic endeavors but also our approach to personal growth, ethical leadership, and community engagement. We encourage our students and faculty alike to embody these principles in both their academic and professional lives, fostering a culture of continuous learning, intellectual curiosity, and respect for diverse perspectives.

title: Educational Philosophy - Leadership and Community Engagement
text: Paragon International University is dedicated to preparing students to become ethical, compassionate, and responsible leaders. We believe that true education extends beyond the classroom, with opportunities for personal development, community service, and co-curricular involvement. Students are encouraged to contribute meaningfully to the wider community and to engage in activities that promote both individual and collective well-being.

title: Accreditation - Accreditation Committee of Cambodia (ACC)
text: Paragon International University has received full accreditation from the Accreditation Committee of Cambodia (ACC). The ACC concluded that Paragon International University fulfilled virtually all requirements of the nine national standards across 73 indicators for accreditation of higher education institutions in Cambodia. The university is committed to continuously improving the quality of its educational services and contributing to the development of human resources in Cambodia.

title: Accreditation - UN Principles for Responsible Management Education (PRME)
text: Paragon International University is the first Cambodian member university of the United Nations' Principles for Responsible Management Education (PRME). The university is integrating the Sustainable Development Goals across its undergraduate and graduate business programs.

title: Accreditation - ASEAN University Network Quality Assurance (AUN-QA)
text: Paragon International University is an ASEAN University Network - Quality Assurance (AUN-QA) Associate Member University. The university is committed to having its academic programs officially assessed and recognized by the regional quality assurance body.

title: Accreditation - Scottish Qualifications Authority (SQA) Approved Center
text: Paragon International University is the first Scottish Qualifications Authority (SQA) Approved Center in Cambodia. Through its SQA-approved programs, the university can offer two-year degree programs that provide internationally recognized educational qualifications. After successfully completing a two-year program, students may gain direct entry to years three and four of bachelor's degree programs at more than fifty SQA partner institutions in countries including the United Kingdom, United States, Australia, Canada, and Singapore.

title: Accreditation - CFA University Affiliation Program
text: Paragon International University's Department of Banking and Finance is recognized as a CFA University Affiliation Program (UAP). The affiliation promotes ethics-based investment education in university programs and helps prepare students for CFA examinations.

title: History of Paragon International University - Establishment and Renaming
text: Paragon International University, formerly known as Zaman University, was established in 2010 as a member of Zaman educational institutions, now under Paragon Education Company. Zaman University was later rebranded and officially recognized as Paragon International University by a sub-decree of the Royal Government of Cambodia on 28 January 2019.

title: History of Paragon International University - University Leadership and Language of Instruction
text: Paragon International University strives to be a leading university in Cambodia in teaching quality, research, and community services while providing internationally recognized programs and contributing to Cambodia's development. Since its inception, the language of instruction at Paragon International University has been English. The current rector is Dr. Bulat Akhmetkarimov. The university is guided by the Board of Directors, chaired by Lok Chumteav Chea Sophakanny, who is also the owner and chair of Paragon Education Company.

title: Office of Student Services - Overview
text: The Office of Student Services (OSS) supports the university community and contributes to the educational goals of Paragon International University. The office provides academic guidance, student support, and services that promote a respectful, supportive, and inclusive university environment. OSS supports students in their academic, personal, and professional development through a range of programs and services. The office encourages student engagement, personal growth, academic achievement, and a strong sense of community within the university. OSS works closely with students, faculty, and staff, as well as external organizations, professional networks, and educational institutions to provide services and activities that support students and contribute to a positive university experience.

title: Student Ambassador Program - Overview
text: The Student Ambassador Program at Paragon International University is designed for students who wish to represent the university by supporting the Office of Public Relations. Student Ambassadors work closely with the Office of Public Relations to carry out events and initiatives that enhance Paragon International University's reputation and image. Student Ambassadors are carefully selected through procedures established by the Office of Public Relations.

title: Student Ambassador Program - Vision and Mission
text: The vision of the Student Ambassador Program is to represent Paragon International University students in outside communities and inspire peers to make a difference in the community. The mission of the Student Ambassador Program is to serve as a bridge between Paragon International University and the local community by working closely with the Office of Public Relations to maintain and enhance the university's image through school-led and community-driven activities.

title: Student Ambassador Program - Roles and Responsibilities
text: The main role of a Student Ambassador at Paragon International University is to inspire, promote, and engage. Student Ambassadors present and share courses and their experiences as students while providing advice and direction to other Paragon.U students. They represent the university and support staff members during events and campaigns outside the university. They help ensure effective and professional communication within and outside the university, initiate Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) projects for the community, negotiate with potential partners, and manage and represent the university through the Paragon.U Student Ambassador and ParagonIU Knowledge Tips social media pages.

title: Student Clubs and Cultural Activities - Overview
text: The Student Clubs and Cultural Activities Center at Paragon International University helps students organize and run cultural activities and student clubs. Students are encouraged to participate in extracurricular activities because these activities can enhance their overall educational experience. The center supports clubs operated through cooperation between students and instructors at Paragon International University.

title: Student Clubs and Cultural Activities - Creating a Student Club
text: Paragon International University allows students to organize and create student clubs based on their interests. Each academic year, the university provides numerous clubs and encourages students to participate in extracurricular activities. The university has made the process of creating new clubs easier so that students have opportunities to establish and participate in additional extracurricular activities. Students can propose a new student club through the Student Clubs and Cultural Activities Center.

title: Student Clubs and Cultural Activities - Available Clubs
text: Student clubs at Paragon International University include Football Club, Guitar Club, Aikido Club, Model UN Club, Traditional Khmer Dance Club, Youth Club, Debate Club, Basketball Club, Robotics Club, Table Tennis Club, International Students Club, and Bookworms Club. The university also provides various student organizations and extracurricular activities that students can organize and participate in based on their interests.

title: Student Council - Overview, Mission and Objectives
text: The Student Council at Paragon International University represents students and enables them to participate in university affairs by working in partnership with University Management, staff, and instructors. Student Council representatives are selected through a voting process among Paragon International University students, with the representatives receiving the most votes becoming members of the Student Council. The mission of the Student Council is to provide a representative structure through which students can become involved in university affairs and work with University Management, staff, and instructors for the benefit of the university and its students. Its main role is to promote the interests of the university and student involvement in university affairs. General objectives include enhancing communication between students, management, staff, and instructors; promoting an environment that supports educational and personal development; promoting friendship and respect among students; supporting management and staff in the development of the university; and representing student views on matters of general concern.

title: Student Council - Key Functions
text: The functions and activities of the Student Council at Paragon International University support the Council's aims and objectives, the development of the university, and the welfare of students. The Student Council works closely with University Management, staff, and instructors; consults regularly with students; and seeks to involve as many students as possible in Council activities. The Student Council also identifies activities it would like to organize, with final decisions on activities agreed upon with university management.

title: Student Council - Activities and Student Support
text: The Student Council at Paragon International University undertakes activities that benefit students and the university community. It presents the views of the student body to university management by listening to students' views and concerns and discussing them with management on behalf of students. It promotes communication within the university through methods such as notice boards and newsletters. The Student Council can support educational development by organizing study groups, homework clubs, and activities such as language clubs. It can contribute to university policy by forming subcommittees, consulting students, staff, and instructors, and presenting the Council's views to University Management. The Student Council can also assist in organizing sports and cultural activities such as sports days, dramas, and musical events. It may organize fundraising events within the university and wider community to raise money for designated charities.

title: Computer Science Major - Program Overview

Students learn computer fundamentals and develop skills for solving IT problems while strengthening their computing, communication, and research abilities. The program teaches students how to specify, develop, and manage computer systems and how to apply appropriate methodologies to hardware, software, and firmware. Students also gain practical experience in programming, modeling, innovation, hands-on projects, and industry internships.

title: Computer Science Major - Career Pathways
text: Graduates of the Computer Science program at Paragon International University can pursue careers in the IT industry and in public and private sector organizations. Career pathways include Management Information Systems roles such as IT Consultant, Database Administrator, and Database Analyst; networking roles such as Network Administrator, Network Engineer, and Network Operations Project Manager; software development roles such as Fullstack Web Developer, Mobile Developer, Software Engineer, Software Architect, and Programming Analyst; Data Mining roles such as Data Analyst; systems roles such as Systems Administrator and Systems Engineer; and telecommunications roles such as Telecommunications Network Engineer. Graduates may also work in IT security management, the computer gaming sector, government agencies, technological startups, or pursue entrepreneurship.

title: Media and Communications Management - Program Overview
text: The B.A. in Media and Communications Management (MCM) at Paragon International University is offered by the Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Languages. The program prepares professionals for the growing media and marketing sectors in Cambodia and Southeast Asia. It provides training in public relations, strategic communication, media business management, marketing, and media production. The curriculum emphasizes technical skills, adaptability, innovation, critical thinking, and ethical practices. The program bridges media studies with business management and incorporates emerging areas such as AI-driven production and transmedia storytelling.

During Years 3 and 4, students undertake specialized and advanced technical training in areas such as Video Production, Film Editing, and Sound Design. The later stage of the program includes professional development and Final Year Project courses that allow students to apply their knowledge to media challenges.

title: SQA Advanced Diploma in Business - Program Overview
text: The SQA Advanced Diploma in Business (GT32 48) at Paragon International University is a two-year international qualification designed to connect academic theory with real-world business practice. It is intended for students who want to enter the workforce or continue toward a bachelor's degree at an international university. The program emphasizes practical learning through real-world case studies, simulations, and actionable business strategies. It also develops five core professional skills: Communication, Numeracy, ICT, Problem Solving, and Teamwork.

title: SQA Advanced Diploma in Business - Curriculum
text: The SQA Advanced Diploma in Business at Paragon International University is delivered over two years and consists of 30 SQA credits. Year 1 focuses on the foundations of business operations. Subjects include Accounting for Business - An Introduction; Business Fundamentals with Emerging Technologies; Business Law: An Introduction; Economic Issues - An Introduction; Managing People and Organisations; Marketing - An Introduction; Communication: Business Communication; Creating a Culture of Customer Care; Human Resource Management: Introduction; IT in Business: Spreadsheets; and Personal Development Planning. Year 1 also includes Graded Unit 1, assessed through a closed-book examination. Year 2 focuses on advanced strategy, leadership, global strategy, and high-level analysis. Subjects include Economics: Micro and Macro Theory and Application; Managing Business Culture and Strategy; Project Management: Strategy, Decision Making, and Risk; International Marketing: An Introduction; Preparing Financial Forecasts; Presentation Skills; Continuous Workforce Development; Business Contractual Relationships; Economics: The World Economy; and Statistics for Business. Year 2 also includes Graded Unit 2, assessed through a practical business project.

title: SQA Advanced Diploma in Business - Academic Pathways
text: After completing the SQA Advanced Diploma in Business, students are eligible to apply for advanced entry into bachelor's degree programs at international universities. Depending on the receiving university's admission requirements and recognition policies, advanced entry may allow students to enter directly into the second or third year of a bachelor's degree. Pathway opportunities include universities in the United Kingdom, Australia, and other countries. Students may also explore progression opportunities with other international institutions depending on their admission and recognition requirements.

title: SQA Advanced Diploma in Business - Program Length and Credits
text: The SQA Advanced Diploma in Business at Paragon International University is delivered over two years and consists of 30 SQA credits. The units are structured to progressively develop business knowledge and professional skills across the two years of study.

title: Master of Business Administration - Overview
text: The Master of Business Administration (MBA) at Paragon International University is designed for working professionals who want to develop leadership, strategic thinking, research, critical thinking, and core business skills without stepping away from their careers. The program requires 48 credits over four semesters. Evening classes are scheduled from 6:30 PM to 8:30 PM. Courses are delivered online, with selected courses also available in hybrid online and on-campus format. The program is taught by PhD-qualified national and international faculty.

title: Master of Business Administration - Complete Curriculum
text: The Master of Business Administration at Paragon International University consists of four semesters totaling 48 credits. title: Master of Science in Management of Information Systems - Overview and Careers
text: The Master of Science in Management of Information Systems (MSc MIS) at Paragon International University prepares students for careers involving the design, analysis, implementation, and operation of computer-based information systems. MIS integrates technology with the functional areas of management and serves as a communication bridge between business needs and technology. Career opportunities include Business Analyst, IT Consultant, Systems Analyst, IT Development Project Leader, Database Administrator, Business Intelligence Analyst, Data Analyst, Web Developer, and Information Systems Manager.

title: Master of Arts in Educational Leadership - Overview
text: The Master of Arts in Educational Leadership (MA EdL) at Paragon International University is designed for professionals seeking career growth and leadership development. It develops knowledge in management, pedagogy, educational leadership, legal and ethical issues in school leadership, curriculum development, finance, human resource management, marketing, strategic planning, research methods, strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making. title: PhD in Management of Information Systems - Overview
text: The Doctor of Philosophy in Management of Information Systems at Paragon International University prepares students to conduct original research in information systems and technology management. The program involves coursework, research papers, and independent dissertation research. Areas include business intelligence, enterprise systems, systems integration, artificial intelligence, data analytics, information systems strategy, ethics, compliance, and research project leadership.

text: The Doctor of Philosophy in Computer Science (PhD CS) at Paragon International University is an advanced research program preparing students for careers in computer science research, teaching, and development. title: PhD in Economics - Overview, Admission and Graduation
text: The Doctor of Philosophy in Economics (PhD ECON) at Paragon International University prepares economists for academic careers and careers requiring advanced doctoral training in international organizations, think tanks, research institutions, government agencies, banks, and insurance companies. text: The Doctor of Philosophy in International Relations (PhD IR) at Paragon International University is a research doctorate designed to develop practitioners and scholars for governmental and non-governmental institutions, the private sector, and research and educational institutions in Cambodia. title: PhD in Educational Leadership - Overview
text: The Doctor of Philosophy in Educational Leadership at Paragon International University is designed to develop practitioners and scholars for work in governmental and non-governmental institutions, the private sector, and research and educational institutions in Cambodia. Elective courses include Foundations of Inquiry and Educational Research, Creativity and Critical Thinking, Global Studies in Education, Philosophy of Education, Leadership: Theory and Practice, Culture, Power, and Education, Special Topics in Educational Leadership I, and Special Topics in Educational Leadership II.

title: Postgraduate Certificate Program - Overview
text: Paragon International University offers Postgraduate Certificates in General Management, Finance, and Educational Leadership. These certificates use postgraduate-level courses and are designed for professional development. The Postgraduate Certificate is not equivalent to a master's degree. The program takes one year, consists of 12 credits and approximately 180 hours, and certificate holders are eligible to continue into the MBA program with partial credit transfer.

title: Postgraduate Certificate Program - Complete Curriculum
text: Paragon International University's Postgraduate Certificate Program offers three specializations, each following a one-year, two-semester study plan. General Management: Semester I - Strategic Leadership, 3 credits; Organizational Behavior and Leadership or Marketing and Brand Management, 3 credits. Semester II - Human Capital Management, 3 credits; Evidence-based Management, 3 credits. Finance: Semester I - Business Accounting, 3 credits; Strategic Leadership, 3 credits. Semester II - Financial Statement Analysis, 3 credits; Corporate Finance, 3 credits. Educational Leadership: Semester I - Human Capital Management, 3 credits; Leadership and Management in Education, 3 credits. Semester II - Strategic Leadership, 3 credits; Critical Perspectives in Education, 3 credits. Each certificate consists of 12 credits.

title: Postgraduate Certificate Program - Fees and Application
text: The Postgraduate Certificate Program at Paragon International University lists a registration fee of USD 500 and tuition of USD 1,200 for the whole program. Applicants can apply by sending their latest CV to sgs@paragoniu.edu.kh. The award is a Postgraduate Certificate and is not equivalent to a master's degree.

title: STAR Program - Scholarship, Workload and Stipend
text: The STAR Student Program at Paragon International University is a scholarship opportunity for students pursuing a master's degree. The program provides a 100% tuition fee scholarship while allowing students to gain teaching, research, and administrative experience and receive a monthly stipend. Qualified applicants may apply for up to two available positions. All positions include a research component required for completion of the master's degree. Master's courses are conducted in the evenings or on weekends. The maximum teaching or administrative workload is 30 hours per week so STAR students have time to study and conduct research during weekdays. The monthly stipend ranges from USD 200 to USD 400 depending on the position and qualifications of the applicant.

title: Why Choose Paragon International University - International Quality Education
text: Paragon International University provides international-quality education through qualified and experienced lecturers who received their degrees from reputable universities around the world. Lecturers typically hold a PhD in their field or at least a master's degree combined with teaching or professional experience. The university has diverse faculty members and staff representing more than 10 nationalities from America, Europe, and Asia. Paragon International University alumni have been admitted to prominent graduate schools in countries including the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, China, South Korea, Japan, Germany, the Netherlands, Thailand, and others.

title: Why Choose Paragon International University - Facilities and Student Support
text: Paragon International University's campus is equipped with modern technology and facilities that support student and staff study and research. The facilities are managed with attention to hygiene and comfort. The university also provides services and programs designed to support academic success and student development, including peer tutoring, counseling services, academic workshops, trips, and other student support programs.

title: Why Choose Paragon International University - International Opportunities and Industry Partnerships
text: Paragon International University provides international opportunities through credit-transferable exchange programs, summer programs, cultural exchange programs, and dual-degree opportunities. Through dual-degree programs, students may earn two degrees after studying for two years at Paragon International University followed by two years or more at a partner university. The university also cooperates with companies and other firms to provide internship placements and site visits that reinforce classroom learning with practical industry experience.

title: Why Choose Paragon International University - Student Life and Extracurricular Activities
text: Paragon International University encourages and supports students to organize and participate in extracurricular activities in addition to their academic studies. These activities allow students to pursue their interests and develop networking skills. The university is located in Toul Kork, Phnom Penh, near entertainment, shopping, and sports facilities where students can spend their free time off campus.

title: Undergraduate Admission - Requirements and Application Process
text: To apply for an undergraduate program at Paragon International University, applicants must provide a high school diploma or a letter from their school certifying that they graduated or will graduate during the current year. Cambodian applicants must have a passing grade from the Grade 12 National Examination (BAC II). Applicants also need a passport or Cambodian National ID card, four photos sized 4x6, and a completed application form. The application form can be obtained from the university Front Desk for USD 10. The undergraduate application process consists of filling out the Enrollment Form, paying the annual registration fee, taking the English Proficiency Test, and paying the tuition fee. After the Enrollment Form and registration fee are submitted, the university informs the student of the scheduled English Proficiency Test date.

Semester I applications open on 1 July 2026 with a listed deadline of 15 November 2026. title: Postgraduate Admission - General Requirements and Application Process
text: The postgraduate admission process at Paragon International University consists of submitting an online application or applying at the campus front desk, review of the application by the Admission Committee, receiving a conditional or unconditional offer, and enrollment at Paragon International University. Applicants without IELTS or TOEFL scores may take the Paragon International University English Proficiency Test. General postgraduate admission requirements include a bachelor's degree diploma or certificate, a Statement of Purpose of approximately 500 words, proof of English proficiency with a minimum TOEFL iBT score of 70, IELTS score of 6.0, or a passing Paragon International University English Proficiency Test, and recommendation letters. A conditional offer may require the applicant to pass the university English test or provide additional documents.

title: Doctoral Admission - PhD and DBA Requirements
text: Doctoral admission requirements vary by program at Paragon International University. For the PhD in International Relations, applicants must hold a master's degree in a relevant field or equivalent, submit an approximately 1000-word research proposal, demonstrate English proficiency with a minimum TOEFL iBT score of 70 or IELTS score of 6.0, provide two academic recommendation letters and a motivation letter, and have a GPA of 3.00 or higher. The listed Doctor of Business Administration admission requirements similarly include a master's degree in a relevant field or equivalent, an approximately 1000-word research proposal, minimum TOEFL iBT 70 or IELTS 6.0, two academic recommendation letters, a motivation letter, and GPA 3.00 or higher.

title: International Student Admission - Requirements and Process
text: International students applying to Paragon International University must submit their application and relevant documents to the Admission Office. Required documents include a high school diploma or a certificate stating that the student will complete high school by a specified date, a high school transcript, and a reference letter from a teacher or principal. A Statement of Purpose is recommended. International students who do not take the Paragon International University Scholarship Exam may be eligible for scholarships of up to 75%, excluding the annual registration fee. Students are responsible for accommodation costs, although the university helps facilitate accommodation. Students are also responsible for visa expenses, while the university facilitates the visa application process. Scholarship holders are subject to the university's Scholarship Policy.

text: The international admission page lists two application intakes. The First Intake application deadline is October 2025 and the Second Intake deadline is March 2026. title: Tuition Fees - Undergraduate and Postgraduate Programs
text: Paragon International University's published tuition fees vary by program. Undergraduate tuition per semester is USD 2,250 for Architecture, Interior Architecture, Civil Engineering, and Industrial Engineering; USD 2,000 for Computer Science, Digital Arts and Design, and Management of Information Systems; and USD 1,750 for Banking and Finance, Business Administration, Economics, International Trade and Logistics, International Relations, Mathematics - Data Science, and Media and Communications Management. The English Preparatory Program costs USD 1,250 per semester. Postgraduate tuition is USD 2,500 per semester for the Master of Business Administration, MSc in Computer Science, and MSc in Management of Information Systems. In addition to tuition, students are required to pay a USD 500 registration fee at the beginning of each academic year. The university's tuition page also states that 50% tuition fee scholarships are available for postgraduate programs.

title: Scholarships - Undergraduate Scholarship Opportunities
text: Paragon International University offers several undergraduate scholarship opportunities. These include scholarships based on National High School Exam results, the Paragon International University Scholarship Exam, Partnership Scholarships for eligible students from partner high schools, National Academic Olympiad scholarships, and departmental scholarships. Scholarship availability, percentages, quotas, application procedures, deadlines, and conditions vary by scholarship and academic year. Some scholarship opportunities may provide up to 100% tuition coverage.

title: Scholarships - Paragon University Scholarship Exam
text: The Paragon International University Scholarship Exam is used to award undergraduate tuition scholarships. For the 2026 scholarship examination, tuition scholarships ranged from 25% to 100%. Exam subjects depended on the applicant's intended major. Most majors used a Mathematics and IQ or general reasoning assessment; International Relations and Media and Communications Management used a Social Science or International Relations-oriented assessment; and Civil Engineering and Industrial Engineering additionally required Physics. Scholarship exam details, dates, quotas, and requirements are announced for each scholarship cycle and can change between academic years.

title: Scholarships - Grade-Based Scholarships
text: Paragon International University offers Grade-Based Scholarships for eligible students based on National High School Examination results and the scholarship allocation for the relevant academic year. The university's scholarship information recognizes BAC II grades A, B, C, and D for varying levels of tuition scholarship, subject to allocated quotas and scholarship conditions. Exact scholarship percentages, quotas, application procedures, and dates should be checked for the current academic year because scholarship calls are updated annually.

title: Faculty of Engineering - Overview and Programs
text: The Faculty of Engineering at Paragon International University prepares students for industry and society through education and research. Its three undergraduate majors and departments are Architecture (ARC), Civil Engineering (CE), and Industrial Engineering (IE).

title: Faculty of Engineering - Teaching and Academic Approach
text: The Faculty of Engineering at Paragon International University emphasizes integrity, creativity, professional practice, and public service. Its learning environment supports education and research to prepare students to address industrial and societal challenges.

title: Faculty of Information and Computer Technologies - Overview and Programs
text: The Faculty of Information and Computer Technologies (ICT Faculty) at Paragon International University offers undergraduate and postgraduate education in computing, information systems, and digital technologies. The faculty has three departments: the Department of Computer Science, the Department of Management of Information Systems, and the Department of Digital Arts and Design. Its undergraduate majors are Computer Science, Digital Arts and Design, and Management of Information Systems. Undergraduate programs lead to bachelor's degrees requiring four years of study. Postgraduate programs associated with the ICT Faculty include the MSc in Management of Information Systems, MSc in Computer Science, PhD in Management of Information Systems, and PhD in Computer Science. The MSc in Management of Information Systems is a two-year mixed-mode program combining coursework and research.

title: Faculty of Information and Computer Technologies - Academic Staff and Leadership

title: Faculty of Information and Computer Technologies - MIS Innovation Lab and Student Opportunities
text: The Faculty of Information and Computer Technologies at Paragon International University provides students with research, innovation, entrepreneurship, and industry-related opportunities. The MIS Innovation Lab serves as a research and innovation facility where ICT students can incubate ideas and explore entrepreneurship. It connects students with the ICT industry and professional and entrepreneurship ecosystems. Students have opportunities for internships, professional networking, and participation in programs at national and international levels. The faculty also develops interdisciplinary skills through activities and events such as hackathons and programming competitions, with the goal of preparing students for current and future industry needs.

title: Faculty of Economics and Administrative Sciences - Overview and Programs
text: The Faculty of Economics and Administrative Sciences (EAS) at Paragon International University offers undergraduate and postgraduate education in business, economics, finance, international trade, logistics, and international relations. The faculty emphasizes student-centered and problem-based learning. Its academic staff includes academicians and professionals with master's degrees from leading universities, relevant professional certifications, and PhD qualifications. The curricula are regularly revised to respond to the needs of society and industry and to meet requirements of relevant accrediting bodies. The faculty offers five undergraduate majors: Banking and Finance, Business Administration, International Trade and Logistics, Economics, and International Relations. Postgraduate programs associated with the faculty include the Master of Business Administration (MBA), Master of Arts in International Relations, Doctor of Business Administration (DBA), and Doctor of Philosophy in International Relations.

text: The Faculty of Economics and Administrative Sciences at Paragon International University values student-centered and problem-based learning. The faculty combines academic knowledge with professional expertise through academic staff who hold graduate degrees, professional certifications, and PhD qualifications. Curricula offered by the faculty are continually revised to respond to changes in society and industry and to satisfy requirements established by relevant accrediting bodies.

title: School of Graduate Studies - Overview
text: The School of Graduate Studies at Paragon International University provides postgraduate degree programs primarily for young professionals in their early and mid-career who want to develop intellectually and improve their opportunities for career advancement. Postgraduate programs are taught in English by highly qualified PhD holders and are designed to respond to the needs of a changing world, including the importance of soft skills and creative thinking in the context of the Fourth Industrial Revolution.

title: English Preparatory Program - Overview and Purpose
text: The English Preparatory Program (EPP) at Paragon International University prepares students for studying in an English-Medium Instruction (EMI) university environment. It strengthens English communication, academic readiness, and confidence for university study and future professional development. Students develop skills needed to understand academic lectures, read textbooks and research materials, write essays, reports and academic assignments, participate in discussions, complete group projects, deliver presentations, and communicate effectively in academic and professional settings. The program uses interactive learning, academic support, practical communication activities, guidance, and feedback to help students adjust successfully to English-medium university learning.

title: English Preparatory Program - Placement Test and Study Pathways
text: Before enrollment in the English Preparatory Program, incoming students take an English Placement Test. The test identifies each student's current English proficiency and determines which courses best match their learning needs. Depending on placement results, students may take courses to improve their academic and professional English or qualify for exemption from selected EPP courses. Possible study pathways include beginning with EPP 101, continuing to EPP 201, or proceeding directly to Academic or Professional English courses. Students with higher English proficiency may receive exemptions from selected courses based on their placement results. The purpose of placement is to ensure that students begin at an appropriate level and receive the support they need for English-medium university study.

title: English Preparatory Program - Learning Outcomes and Career Preparation
text: The English Preparatory Program develops practical English communication skills for university study and professional contexts. By completing the program, students are expected to demonstrate CEFR-aligned proficiency across listening, speaking, reading, and writing at a level appropriate for undergraduate study; apply integrated language skills to academic tasks such as essay writing, oral presentations, and group projects; develop transferable skills including collaboration, digital literacy, and problem-solving; use reflective practices to improve their learning; and communicate effectively in intercultural and academic communities. EPP skills also support internships, professional communication, future careers, and international workplace environments. English for Specific Purposes (ESP) focuses on communication related to a student's academic discipline and future profession.

title: English Boot Camp - Program Details, Schedule and Fee
text: The English Boot Camp at Paragon International University is an intensive Academic English program designed to strengthen English skills, build confidence, and help students gain the qualifications needed to enroll in university degree programs and enter Year 1. Successful completion makes students eligible to enroll in Year 1 for the upcoming academic year. The program focuses on Listening, Speaking, Reading, and Writing for university success. It consists of 10 weeks of study with 3 hours of daily instruction plus 1 hour of independent learning. For the 2026 program, the listed dates are 20 July 2026 to 30 September 2026. Available class times are 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM or 1:00 PM to 4:00 PM. No prior qualification is required. The program fee is USD 750 and capacity is limited to the first 50 students. Students can apply through the early registration form.

title: Office of Research - Overview and Research Collaboration
text: Research at Paragon International University spans disciplines including civil engineering, international relations, computer science, economics, and other academic fields. Full-time and part-time faculty participate in national, regional, and global research communities. University research is overseen by the Office of Research together with the Research Committee. The university seeks research partnerships with individual scholars and institutions sharing common research interests and maintains Memorandums of Understanding supporting collaborative research with universities in Southeast Asia and beyond. Paragon International University also operates a Research Affiliate program supporting foreign scholars who plan to reside in Cambodia while conducting field research.

title: Office of Research - Research Activities and Student Research
text: Paragon International University promotes research through faculty publications, student research, research-methods training, and academic collaboration. The university has collaborated with Konrad Adenauer Stiftung in organizing a monthly research colloquium where junior and senior scholars present research for discussion among academic and think-tank communities in Phnom Penh. Paragon International University is also part of the Comparative Education Society of Cambodia, organized by the Cambodia Development Research Institute (CDRI), which works with institutions in Cambodia to understand the needs, challenges, and future development of education. The university places significant emphasis on research and research-methods training in undergraduate and graduate curricula and supports the development of the next generation of Cambodian researchers.

title: Office of Research - Research Ethics and Human Subjects
text: Paragon International University requires faculty and student research to follow global best practices in research ethics. For research involving human subjects, review and approval must be obtained from the University Research Committee. Visiting scholars conducting human-subject research are expected to have Institutional Review Board (IRB) or equivalent approval from their home institutions.

title: Center for Professional Education - Overview and Training Programs
text: The Center for Professional Education (CPE) at Paragon International University provides professional education and training for organizations and individuals. CPE aims to build long-term relationships by developing training and education programs tailored to specific organizational and individual needs. Its broader goal is to contribute to Cambodia's business environment through human-capital and institutional development. CPE draws on expertise from Paragon International University's academic units and faculty to provide professional development opportunities. Programs range from skills and career development to supervisory and managerial training and professional executive programs. CPE also provides training in areas such as digital literacy, Information and Communication Technologies, professional English, communication, negotiation, finance-related English, tourism communication, and career preparation.

title: Center for Professional Education - Extension Program
text: The Center for Professional Education's Extension Program allows members of the public, including high school graduates, working adults, and students from other universities, to take regular daytime Paragon International University courses during the Fall and Spring semesters. Concurrent enrollment becomes available after enrollment for current Paragon International University students has ended and is subject to available seats. Extension students are responsible for meeting the prerequisites of the courses they want to take. The listed cost is USD 300 per unit for undergraduate courses and USD 350 per unit for graduate courses. Paragon International University alumni receive a 20% discount. Registration is completed at the front desk. If a seat is available, the trainee pays 50% of the course fee to reserve a place on a first-come, first-served basis, with the remaining balance due by the end of the eighth week of the semester.

title: Center for Professional Education - Certificates
text: Trainees in Center for Professional Education programs may receive one of two types of certificates. A Certificate of Participation indicates that the trainee attended the program. A Certificate of Completion indicates that the trainee performed the required work and met the requirements of the course.

title: Partner Universities - 2026 University Partnerships
text: Paragon International University maintains international university partnerships supporting student exchange, faculty exchange, research, conferences, cultural programs, academic projects, and degree pathways. Partner universities listed for 2026 include BINUS University in Indonesia; Centennial College in Canada; Central Queensland University in Australia; Endicott College at Woosong University in South Korea; Karakalpak State University in Uzbekistan; Hankuk University of Foreign Studies (HUFS) in South Korea; Ho Chi Minh University in Vietnam; Hof University of Applied Sciences in Germany; Humboldt University in Germany; University of Mataram in Indonesia; King Mongkut's University of Technology in Thailand; Ludwig Maximillian's University in Germany; SDU University in Kazakhstan; Solbridge International School of Business at Woosong University in South Korea; Shih Chien University; SRH University Heidelberg in Germany; University of the Philippines Diliman in the Philippines; Ala-Too International University in Kyrgyzstan; Aditya Institute of Management in India; International Burch University in Bosnia and Herzegovina; University of Foggia in Italy; National Taipei University; Woosong University in South Korea; and the Philippines Institute of Engineers. title: Partner Universities - Exchange and Degree Pathway Opportunities
text: Paragon International University's university partnerships support different academic opportunities depending on the institution. Examples listed for 2026 include student exchange for Business Administration, Banking and Finance, International Trade and Logistics, Computer Science, Management of Information Systems, Engineering, English, and International Relations; student and faculty exchanges; PhD and research projects; joint research and conferences; joint cultural programs and projects; MBA study; and degree pathways. title: Study Abroad and Exchange - Exchange Programs and Scholarships
text: Paragon International University supports students who want to study abroad through its academic and administrative staff and Office of International Cooperation. Students who perform successfully during their first one to two years at Paragon International University may have opportunities to receive exchange scholarships for one semester or one academic year abroad, with overseas study receiving credit toward their Paragon International University degree. The university's study-abroad page lists active exchange-scholarship cooperation with Hunan University in China, Solbridge International School of Business in South Korea, Shih Chien University in Taiwan, and the University of the Philippines Diliman. It also lists possible exchange placements and scholarships at American University and Salem State University in the United States, Canadore College in Canada, Chiang Mai University and King Mongkut University of Technology in Thailand, Hankuk University in South Korea, Liaoning University in China, Shih Chien University in Taiwan, and President University in Indonesia.

title: Study Abroad and Exchange - 2+2, 3+1 and International Degree Pathways
text: Paragon International University offers international degree pathways that allow students to begin their undergraduate studies at Paragon and complete part of their degree abroad. A 2+2 program generally means studying for two years at Paragon International University followed by two years at a partner university abroad, with degree credit and qualifications supported through credit-transfer or dual-degree arrangements. The study-abroad page lists 2+2 opportunities with Mahidol University in Thailand, Solbridge School of Business in South Korea, Southern University of Science and Technology in China, and Shih Chien University in Taiwan. Shih Chien University is also listed with a 3+1 option. The page additionally states that an agreement with Universiti Teknologi Petronas in Malaysia for a 1+3 arrangement in Information and Computer Technologies was in its final stages; because this is described as an agreement in progress rather than an established pathway, students should verify its current availability with the university.

title: Study Abroad and Exchange - Foundation and Postgraduate Study Abroad
text: Paragon International University's study-abroad page describes a Foundation Studies program operated with the Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT) in Australia. The program is designed to prepare students for undergraduate entry in Australia, with the page stating guaranteed acceptance to RMIT after successful completion of the one-year course. title: Available Bachelor Programs
text: Paragon International University offers undergraduate degree programs including Civil Engineering, Architecture, Computer Science, Management of Information Systems, Business Administration, Banking & Finance, International Relations, International Trade and Logistics, and Industrial Engineering.

title: Payment And Study Duration
text: You just need to make the payment of the registration fee in advance, yet you don’t need to pay any tuition fee. However, please note that the maximum period of study for a 4-year degree program cannot be longer than 6 academic years.

title: Refund Policy
text: Yes, you can do so. However, the application and registration fees are non-refundable.

title: Admission Application Process
text: You can apply online for admission or simply walk into our campus to apply. Assistance is provided for walk-in applicants. Please note that international applications are subject to approval of the registrar and the response process may take 5 working days. International students can apply and study at Paragon.U. Please see the information for international students here or find at Admission > Admission Requirements > International

title: Admission Requirements
text: Admission requirements and the process are explained under the Admissions page of the university website.

title: Academic Calendar
text: In an academic year at Paragon International University, there are 2 semesters followed by a summer term. Semester I begins in early November and finishes in late February. Semester II begins in mid-March and ends in late July. For more updated information, please see Academic Calendar

title: Bachelor Degree Programs
text: Paragon International University offers undergraduate (Bachelor’s) degree education in the following programs: Civil Engineering (CE) Architecture (ARC) Computer Science (CS) Management of Information Systems (MIS) Business Administration (BUS) Banking & Finance (BAF) International Relations (IR) International Trade and Logistics (ITL) Industrial Engineering (IE)

title: University Education Quality
text: Yes. We offer a university education with a strong curriculum at international standards. Our alumni are admitted to prominent graduate schools in the USA, UK, Australia, China, South Korea, Japan, Germany, Thailand, the Netherlands, and many others.

title: Lecturers And Faculty
text: Lecturers at Paragon International University are qualified and experienced academicians and professionals who received their graduate and postgraduate degrees from reputable universities around the globe. They typically have a PhD in their field or at least a Master’s Degree with teaching/professional experience. Paragon International University is proud of its body of diverse faculty members and staff of over 10 different nationalities from America, Europe and Asia.

title: Course Schedule
text: Course schedules are arranged by the Provost’s Office and typically spread over the week between 8 AM and 5 PM. In addition to their regular class hours, students are expected to spend 20 to 25 hours per week for independent study and research. In the English Preparatory Program, the sessions usually run from 8 AM – 12 PM, from Monday to Friday, and learners are expected to do practice and self-study in the afternoons.

title: Attendance Policy
text: Attendance is a component of the grading system and it comprises 10% of the overall grade. Therefore, students are strongly encouraged to attend and participate in all class activities. Absenteeism will result in low grades or failure in the course.

title: Scholarship Eligibility General
text: Students who passed the high school national exam from any academic year or will take it this year can apply for the Paragon International University Scholarship Examination.

title: Scholarship Examination Schedule
text: The Scholarship Examination for the 2024 intake was conducted online on 07 September 2024.

title: Scholarship Application Procedure
text: Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview by the Reviewing Committee.

title: Rector's Scholarship
text: Application for Rector’s Scholarship for Academic Year 2025-2026 is open until 23 October 2025. The Rector’s Scholarship is awarded based on a holistic admissions process. Candidates must submit an application with their portfolio and provide all required documents online through the main website.

title: Partnership Scholarship
text: Students who have graduated or will graduate from one of Paragon International University's partner high schools are eligible to apply for the Partnership Scholarship. The number of scholarships, terms, conditions, forms, and registration details are available through the school's administrator.

title: Partner High Schools
text: Partners of Paragon International University include Paragon International School, NTC Group, SIS International School, and The Westline School. Scholarship provisions are based on agreements between ParagonU and its high school partners.

title: National Academic Olympiad Scholarship
text: Students who passed the high school national exam and are awardees of the National Academic Olympiads ranked from 1 to 10 in Math, Physics, and Khmer Literature categories in the most recent academic year are eligible to receive a full tuition fee scholarship.

title: High School Exam Grade Scholarship
text: Students who passed the high school national exam in the most recent academic year with grades A, B, C, or D may receive different percentages of tuition fee scholarships based on allocated departmental quota.

title: Scholarship Exam Types
text: The Paragon International University Scholarship Exam is a 2-hour paper-based multiple-choice test measuring students’ general ability to succeed in study programs at Paragon International University. Exam types include General Reasoning, International Relations, and Physics.

title: General Reasoning Exam
text: Applicants interested in fields other than International Relations must take the General Reasoning Exam. It includes Mathematical Reasoning, Logical Reasoning, and Verbal Reasoning questions. The exam duration is two hours.

title: Physics Exam
text: Applicants interested in Civil Engineering must additionally take the Physics Exam. The Physics Exam duration is one hour.

title: International Relations Exam
text: Applicants interested in International Relations must take the International Relations Exam. The exam tests general knowledge of current events and history, and includes a short logical reasoning section.

title: Scholarship Coverage
text: Scholarships offered at Paragon International University are tuition fee discounts only. They do not cover registration fees. Students with a 100% scholarship still need to pay the annual registration fee.

title: Scholarship Exam Frequency
text: Paragon International University Scholarship Examinations are administered only once every academic year.

title: International Applicant Scholarship
text: International applicants residing in Cambodia can apply for scholarships through the Scholarship Exam.

title: Scholarship Duration
text: A scholarship is valid for 2 semesters spent at the English preparatory school and 10 semesters spent in the undergraduate program. The scholarship does not include the registration fee.

title: University Contact Information
text: Paragon International University is open Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM. Phone: 023 996 111, 017 996 111, 015 996 111.

title: Registration Fee
text: Students are required to pay a $500 registration fee at the beginning of each academic year.

title: Scholarship Availability
text: Paragon International University offers a wide range of scholarships to help students finance their studies. A 50% tuition fee scholarship is available.

title: Visa Support

title: Living Expenses
text: Students need to prepare money for living costs including accommodation, food, books, entertainment, clothing, phone bills, local travel, and laundry. Expenses vary depending on lifestyle and spending habits. Paragon International University recommends budgeting around $800 per month for living costs.
